      var eleCollection = document.querySelectorAll("input[type='hidden'].gl-dynamic-scripts");
      var isPageSpeedLandingPage = 0;
      if(eleCollection && eleCollection.length > 0) {
        window.afterFirstFoldScripts = window.afterFirstFoldScripts || [];
        for(var i=0;i<eleCollection.length;i++) {
          var item = eleCollection[i];
          if(item.hasAttribute("data-after-first-fold") && isPageSpeedLandingPage) {
            window.afterFirstFoldScripts.push(item);
            return;
          }
          var currentVal = item.value, initfn = item.getAttribute("data-init-fn");
          if (currentVal && currentVal.length > 0) {
            loadScript(currentVal, {defer: true, async: false, forceCallback: true}, window[initfn]);
            console.log("Loaded : ", currentVal);
          }
        }
      }
    });
  </script>
